643-4779-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
643-4779-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability, giving Krark-Clan Grunt +1/+0 and first strike until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.

728-4871-8168.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token with flying due to Draconic Visitor.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

728-4419--5.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it and at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Renata.
Remove a -1/-1 counter and a +1/+1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat

1981-2292-2415-6719.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2292-2415-6719.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Dazzling Angel triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

4613-4968-6843-7803.notablePrerequisites: Brad Boimler has been tapped this turn.
4613-4968-6843-7803.description:
Activate Anti-Venom using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself and putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to its replacement effect and Brad Boimler.
Activate Anti-Venom using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

4659-5346-7311-7810.description:
Activate Improvised Arsenal by paying {4}{R}, creating a token copies of it plus a Food artifact token due to Tippy-Toe.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Improvised Arsenal token and the Food token, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Crime Novelist triggers twice, putting two +1/+1 counters on it and adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.

670-1619-3742-6149.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-3742-6149.description:
Cast Phantom Steed by paying its mana cost.
When Phantom Steed enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, exiling Stirring Bard until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Phantom Steed.
Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield, causing Stirring Bard to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Stirring Bard enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Stirring Bard trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Phantom Steed from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Phantom Steed enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, exiling Stirring Bard until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Phantom Steed.
Repeat from step 5.

2034-2146-4871-7147-7654.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Sundering Archaic by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Cloud Key.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1123-5686-6972.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Flayer of the Hatebound
When Flayer of the Hatebound dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Flayer of the Hatebound enters, it triggers, dealing damage equal to its power to any target.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Flayer of the Hatebound
When Flayer of the Hatebound dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Flayer of the Hatebound enters, it triggers, dealing damage equal to its power to any target.
Resolve both Shilgengar abilities from step 1 and 4.
Repeat.
1123-5686-6972.notes: If Flayer of the Hatebound starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

4186-6996-7399.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4186-6996-7399.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Bogwater Lumaret triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-4689-7175.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4689-7175.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Otharri as attackers.
Otharri triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

4668-4970-5671-5751.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one land card in hand.
Opponents have drawn at least one card this turn.
4668-4970-5671-5751.description:
Cast Chromatic Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0} and discarding a land card from your hand.
Activate Chromatic Sphere by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1} and causing you to mill two cards and return a land card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3967-6972-7160.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Arcbound Whelp.
When Arcbound Whelp dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Whelp's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Whelp from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

483-2921-5170-6132.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Cruel Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Cruel Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Cruel Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

2079-3490-6723-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
2079-3490-6723-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

662-1978-5711.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 4 or greater.
662-1978-5711.description:
Cause Fanatic of Rhonas to become an artifact using Liquimetal Coating.
Activate Fanatic of Rhonas by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Fanatic of Rhonas.
Repeat from step 2.

2770-3967-5571--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat from step 2.

1409-3875-4826-6839.description:
Activate Ignis by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Ignis enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Ignis.
Resolve the Ignis trigger, causing you to look at the top six cards of your library and put a land card from among them onto the battlefield untapped due to Archelos
If you put a land onto the battlefield this way, Tireless Provisioner triggers, creating a Treasure token. Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Repeat.
1409-3875-4826-6839.notes: This combo can fail if Ignis does not reveal a land. You can use additional mana to restart the combo if desired should this happen. The combo also assumes every land you grab will be mana-producing.

1671-5451-5702-6664.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
1671-5451-5702-6664.description:
Play Simic Growth Chamber. When it enters untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel, Simic Growth Chamber and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Wayward Swordtooth.
Because of the additional Wayward Swordtooth token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

510-2281-5231.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Mistmoon Griffin.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Mistmoon Griffin, adding {R}.
When Mistmoon Griffin dies, it and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Mistmoon Griffin from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Mistmoon Griffin trigger, failing to exile it as it is not in your graveyard and then returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

222-527-2292-4359.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-2292-4359.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Viscera Seer twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

2506-3706.description:
Cast Wren's Run Packmaster by paying its mana cost.
When Wren's Run Packmaster enters the battlefield, its champion ability and Molten Echoes triggers.
Resolve the Molten Echoes trigger, creating a token copy of Wren's Run Packmaster with haste.
When the Wren's Run Packmaster token enters the battlefiled, its champion ability triggers, exiling the nontoken Wren's Run Packmaster until the token Wren's Run Packmaster leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the champion ability from step 2, exiling the token Wren's Run Packmaster.
The token Wren's Run Packmaster leaves the battlefield, returning the nontoken Wren's Run Packmaster from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

654-851-5702-5954.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
654-851-5702-5954.notablePrerequisites: Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
654-851-5702-5954.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere tokens enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor and Springheart Nantuko trigger twice.
Resolve both Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping both Everywhere tokens.
Holding priority, activate the Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and create a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

2583-5668-5870-5874.description:
Activate Whirler Virtuoso by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
When the Thopter enters the battlefield, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to get {E}{E} and gain 1 life.
Sphinx of the Revelation triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}.
Repeat.

693-1368.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least five cards in hand.
You have at least three additional cards in your graveyard.
693-1368.description:
Cast Path of the Pyromancer from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {4}{R} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to discard your hand, add {R} for each card discarded this way, then draw a number of cards equal to the number of cards you discarded plus one.
Repeat.

1170-1393-1482-5034.description:
Cast Sol Ring by paying {1}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Aether Channeler.
When Aether Channeler enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Jeweled Lotus from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Jeweled Lotus by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Aether Channeler.
When Aether Channeler enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Sol Ring from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

330-2068-2398-4508.notablePrerequisites: Vial Smasher in any zone.Vial Smasher and You control at least one additional artifact and/or creature.
330-2068-2398-4508.description:
Activate Malcolm by paying {1} and sacrificing another artifact or creature, targeting an opponent.
Ashnod triggers, copying Malcolm's ability, targeting an opponent.
Resolve a Malcolm ability, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

205-1908.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Rionya triggers, creating at least one token copy of Azor with haste.
Put all but the nontoken Azor into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Azor token(s) enters-the-battlefield ability trigger, preventing opponents from casting instants or sorceries during their next turn.
Repeat each turn.

719-3466-5038.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield.
"Scarecrow" chosen with Xenograft.
719-3466-5038.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield.
Reaper King triggers, destroying target nontoken creature an opponent controls.
The creature dies, triggering Overseer of the Damned, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
The Zombie enters the battlefield as a Scarecrow due to Xenograft, triggering Reaper King, destroying target nontoken creature an opponent controls.
Repeat from step 3.
This loop will also repeat whenever another creature enters the battlefield under your control.

2178-2837-4050-5309.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Black Market Tycoon.
Black Market Tycoon does not have summoning sickness.
2178-2837-4050-5309.description:
Activate Black Market Tycoon by tapping it, creating either a 2/2 Cat or a 3/1 Dog creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Cat or Dog, adding one mana of any color.
The Cat or Dog dies, triggering Black Market Tycoon, untapping Black Market Tycoon.
Repeat.

765-1479-2638.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
765-1479-2638.description:
Play Guildless Commons.
When Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, it, Tireless Tracker, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Guildless Commons from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, it and Tireless Tracker trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

3732-3750.notablePrerequisites:
Lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}{R}{R}.
You control a creature that can attack this turn, and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
3732-3750.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using any creature.
Nature's Will triggers, tapping all lands the defending opponent controls and untapping all lands you control.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat.
